notes.title: Kindred Spirits Drama CDs now available in DLC format!
notes.content:
Since Steam is retiring the video streaming service on Nov 1st, 2022, the Kindred Spirits on the Roof Drama CD series are now available in DLC format!

- Those of you who have already purchased the Drama CDs can continue to enjoy them the way they are.  

- Purchasers of the new DLCs can enjoy the Drama CD videos from the launch menu and find the extra contents in the local game folder.

The new Drama CD DLCs will be on a 40% off launch discount for 1 week.

notes.title: Kindred Spirits on the Roof base upgrade
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/995610/Kindred_Spirits_on_the_Roof_Full_Chorus/

In order to support the DLC upgrade of Kindred Spirits on the Roof Full Chorus, we have updated the base build which also supports multi-OS platforms: Windows, Linux, and Mac. 

[u]Important Note:[/u]
The save data from the old game build can't be used in the new build.  

If you want to go back to where you were in the original build, please follow these instructions: 

1. Right click "Kindred Spirits on the Roof" in the Steam libraries.
2. Select "Properties"
3. Select "BETAS"
4. Select "ks-original - Kindred Spirits Original Version" from the pull down menu and close the properties window.

In order to go back and access the new build, select "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs" from the BETA pull down menu. Only the new build is upgradable to Full Chorus.

notes.title: Kindred Spirits Drama CDs Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Kindred Spirits Drama CDs Coming in April![/h1]

We’re proud to announce our expansion of the Kindred Spirits franchise, and our very first release of a new product–drama CDs!

Each of the four drama CDs tell sequels to the stories of each of the couples in the original games. The first follows Ano, as Yuna, Hina, and Nena pretend to be her girlfriends in order to throw off some stalkers. In the second, Youka and Kiri realize they’re repeating the same dates with their partner, so they both agree to have the other plan their next date. The third showcases Miki, Maki, Matsuri, and Miyu as they all share a vacation to the beach. Then, in the final drama CD, the broadcasting club hosts a radio show during a sale at the local shopping district.

All four drama CDs will be sold both on Steam and MangaGamer as subtitled videos for $9.99 each. The first Kindred Spirits drama CD will be available this April, and we hope to release the successive drama CDs roughly one month following the previous volume’s release. We will also be carrying limited copies of the original Japanese drama CDs at future conventions throughout this year for those who would like to own the originals in pure audio format.

Be sure to check out the game's website for the latest news regarding the Drama CDs: http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/

notes.title: Kindred Spirits Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Kindred Spirits on the Roof is now available on Steam![/h1]

The first uncut yuri visual novel is now on Steam! Join Yuna and the ghosts haunting her as they play cupid for all the lesbian couples in school, all in hopes of figuring out how girls make love with each other!

Help spread the word on twitter with #KindredSpirits and introduce everyone to the best new yuri game available! Together we can create a #yuritopia!
